$comment: Where the Pixel tip is anchored. Contract addresses are public information —
the whole point is that strangers can check them without asking us.
Both venues share an address because CREATE derives it from sender + nonce,
so the same anchorer key at nonce 0 lands identically on every chain.
Anchoring proves publication time and immutability afterwards. It does NOT
prove the anchored root is correct — see docs/ANCHORING.md.
